title: REQ · A deriveStage helper maps Round and execution status to a lifecycle stage
summary: Pure function returns the current stage from Round status and optional execution status
description: Context: stageIndex maps only Round status. Desired behavior: deriveStage(roundStatus, executionStatus?) returns the later of the Round-derived stage and the execution-derived stage (RUNNING→DEVELOPING, AWAITING_APPROVAL or APPROVED→PUBLISHING, COMPLETED→COMPLETED; QUEUED/FAILED add nothing). Expected result: a stage string usable as LifecycleStepper status. Why: Round status alone lags execution progress.
acceptance_criteria: Given roundStatus CLOSED and executionStatus RUNNING, when deriveStage is called, then it returns DEVELOPING.
Given roundStatus OPEN and no execution status, when deriveStage is called, then it returns OPEN.
Given roundStatus PUBLISHING and executionStatus RUNNING, when deriveStage is called, then it returns PUBLISHING (never moves backwards).
